get.description: Returns a paginated list of the account's subscriptions, newest first (`created_at` descending). Filters are combinable and every one of them is optional; with none set, subscriptions in every status are returned. 1-indexed pagination.

parameters.name: X-Account-Code
parameters.description: The `account_id` found in your [Yuno Dashboard](https://dashboard.y.uno/developers) (UUID). Required — the list is always scoped to a single account. Omitting it returns `400 INVALID_PARAMETERS` ("x-account-code header is required.").

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: Filter by the customer that owns the subscription (`customer_payer.id`, UUID). A value that isn't a UUID returns `400 BAD_REQUEST` ("Invalid customer_id.").

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Accepts several values separated by commas, matching any of them — `ACTIVE,PAUSED`. Values must be spelled exactly as in [Subscription statuses](/reference/subscriptions/status-subscriptions); an unknown one returns `400 BAD_REQUEST` ("Invalid status: FOO.").

parameters.name: plan_id
parameters.description: Filter by the [plan](/reference/plans/the-plan-object) the subscription is linked to (UUID). A plan with no subscribers — or one that doesn't exist — returns an empty list, not an error. A value that isn't a UUID returns `400 BAD_REQUEST` ("Invalid plan_id.").

parameters.name: created_at_from
parameters.description: Only return subscriptions created at or after this instant (ISO 8601 with offset, inclusive). A value that doesn't parse returns `400 BAD_REQUEST` ("Invalid created_at_from.").

parameters.name: created_at_to
parameters.description: Only return subscriptions created at or before this instant (ISO 8601 with offset, inclusive). A value that doesn't parse returns `400 BAD_REQUEST` ("Invalid created_at_to.").

parameters.name: payment_method_type
parameters.description: Filter by the subscription's payment method type, for example `CARD`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-indexed page number. Must be >= 1, else `400 BAD_REQUEST` ("The page must be greater than or equal to 1.").

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size. Must be between 1 and 100 inclusive, else `400 BAD_REQUEST` ("The size must be greater than or equal to 1." if too low, "The size must be at most 100." if too high).

id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription.
The unique identifier of the customer.

frequency.description: `null` on subscriptions billed with `billing_date` instead of a frequency.

billing_cycles.description: Same semantics as on [The Subscription Object](/reference/subscriptions/the-subscription-object) — `current` is the next cycle to be charged, not the one in progress.

type.description: The payment method type, for example `CARD`.

plan_id.description: The plan the subscription is linked to, or `null` for subscriptions created with a raw `amount`/`frequency`.

current_period_start.description: Same semantics as on [The Subscription Object](/reference/subscriptions/the-subscription-object): start of the billing period the subscription is currently in.

current_period_end.description: End of the billing period the subscription is currently in. Equal to `billing_cycles.next_at`.

page.description: The page returned — echoes the request.

size.description: The page size returned — echoes the request.

total.description: Total subscriptions matching the filters, across every page.

messages: The page must be greater than or equal to 1.
